runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game diner_l4 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/system-11/diner-game-on-23.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. The gameplay run's state directory held only the .nv file written by the initialization run (tools/harness-scenarios/system-11/diner-nvram-init.json); its public 23 timeline is 0 in attract mode, 1 from the start press, 0 at the third tilt, 1 for ball 2 and 0 at game over.

named_action_observations.label: start button (public 3) after two coins in attract mode, where public 23 is 0: the ROM starts a game and raises public 23 during the press
third plumb-bob pulse (public 1) on ball 1: the display reads TILT TILT and the ROM drops public 23, raising the Back Box Relay (10)

the tilted ball drained to the outhole, was kicked out (1) and closed trough switch 11 (public 11): the ROM starts ball 2 and raises public 23 again; transitioned_solenoid_addresses covers this step and the checkpoint that waits for 23

ball 3 drained and closed trough switch 11 (public 11): after its bonus the ROM ends the game and drops public 23; public 23 stayed 1 through balls 2 and 3. transitioned_solenoid_addresses covers this step and the checkpoint that waits for 23

raw_runs.name: diner-l4-game-on-23
raw_runs.nvram_initialization: Fresh state; copied only diner_l4-nvram-init/state/nvram/diner_l4.nv (SHA-256 d82605f51f3564020917dc5bf47dadcb704ff470ae56a035784cc44965097339) from the separately retained initialization run, because a Diner ROM booted from empty NVRAM stops on FACTORY SETTING

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The alphanumeric display text is the harness's own segment decoding. Output checkpoints require each 23 transition and every serve and drain, so the run fails closed. Exact external directory manifest diner_l4/manifest.json SHA-256 77c20de8a806c3ebb2e32b18ea500a26975d64b50fc4024977b1938ffe574818 (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py); it lists the raw trace, the copied scenario and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes. The initialization run's own directory manifest diner_l4-nvram-init/manifest.json SHA-256 bfdf8f48bfb1404915422b3c66bac4c4b82dfdb8cae08f5e5fabf8c0bcaa235a lists its trace, scenario and the .nv file it wrote.
